executive_brief.title: Neural 3D Mesh Extraction Stabilized
executive_brief.detail: COMVS-GS fuses MVS priors with 3DGS, enabling production teams to extract watertight collision surfaces directly from camera footage without manual sculpting passes.

executive_brief.title: MoonRay Integrates MaterialX
executive_brief.detail: DreamWorks' MoonRay completes its first ASWF open-source release with native MaterialX support. LookDev authored in DCC tools renders directly in MoonRay without custom shader recreation.
